Notes: Full CDIAL tuṇḍa subsection 1 explicitly gives Oriya tuṇḍa lips/mouth/beak and Sambalpur tũḍ mouth. The selected Adivasi Oriya tuṇḍ and Bhatri tũḍə mouth responses fit this u-vowel branch; final vowel and nasal notation remain intact. Turner treats the ultimate origin as non-Aryan, probably Munda, and allows dialectal and expressive changes. The survey neutral mouth gloss is preserved without imposing an older contemptuous register. Local transmission remains unresolved. Exact response: tũḍə. Joint SIL review 2026-09-14.
